description:
Swimming Pool Tiles 007 are blue pool tiles with white border edging: a blue mosaic lining outlined by a clean white edge as shown in the product photo, for a classic, crisp pool design.

## How they look
The blue mosaic lining sets the water colour, and the white border draws a sharp outline around the pool. This classic pool tile design tends to suit both modern and traditional houses, because the white edge makes the pool shape easy to read from a distance.

## Where they work
- **Blue mosaic pool lining** for walls and floor.
- **White pool edge tiles** at the waterline or around the top of the walls.
- **Step and bench edges**, where a white line marks each level.

The white frame also helps the eye judge where the pool ends, which is useful in a garden at dusk. Keep in mind that white edges show waterline marks sooner, so plan for regular brushing.

## Good to know
- Category: swimming pool tiles
- Look: blue mosaic lining with a white border (from the product photo)
- Size, thickness and finish are not listed online yet; the sales team confirms them with your quote.

Set the border level first and tile the lining up to it, so the white line runs straight around the pool. Use a pool-grade adhesive and grout for a wet, treated area.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715), send your pool size and city for a dated quote, and compare it with the [blue and white accent mosaic 006](/products/swimming-pool-tiles-006) in the [swimming pool tiles range](/categories/swimming-pool-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of blue pool tiles with a white border in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the pattern, the area to cover and delivery, so send your pool measurements and city on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Does a white pool border get dirty quickly?
faqs.a: It shows waterline scum and scale sooner than a dark border. Brushing the waterline regularly and keeping the water balanced keeps it bright.

faqs.q: White border or patterned border: which suits a home pool?
faqs.a: A white border gives a clean, classic outline and works with most houses; a patterned border adds colour and character. Many owners choose white for modern homes and pattern for courtyard or traditional styles.
